topSignals.title: Quiet day continues — Elcogen now 52 days quiet, Topsoe 77 days; no genuinely new item found in any monitored section today.
topSignals.text: Dedicated English- and German-language searches for both priority stacks, the Tier 2 dedicated rotation (Sunfire, SolydEra) and sweep, the Tier 3 dedicated rotation (cycle 9, round 2: Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Weichai, OxEon Energy, Nexceris) and two further Tier 3 sweeps, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler, regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP, and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items. A follow-up attempt to verify yesterday's flagged "Renewable Innovations" DOE fuel-cell/AI-datacenter item failed again (source fetch error); it remains unconfirmed and on watch, not added to the SOFC entrant list. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21, 2026 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 52 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since the Aug 27, 2026 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset, confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 77 days quiet; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by PTX/ammonia/SAF/blue-hydrogen news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation (Sunfire, SolydEra — new cycle, round 1): no new item for either; both companies' top headlines remain the standing Sunfire Schwarzheide SOEC commissioning story and SolydEra's PMX platform/Dynelectro background.
Today's Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item beyond already-logged Bloom/Oracle/NTT DATA background recirculated by aggregator sites.

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — cycle 9, round 2 (Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Weichai, OxEon Energy, Nexceris): no new items for any of the six; results repeated the standing Doosan-Reverion $76.7-78M SOFC stack-supply story, Weichai's Ceres-licensed stationary SOFC/CE-certification background, SK Ecoplant's 2021-2023 Korean heat-supply/data-center items, OxEon's 2024 $36M DOE hydrogen-funding award, and Nexceris's 2024-2025 $60M SOEC scale-up deal.
Tier 3 sweep — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR Doosan Fuel Cell OR SK ecoplant": no new item; recycled the standing Doosan-Reverion stack-supply background.
Tier 3 sweep — "OxEon Energy OR Nexceris OR Kawasaki Heavy Industries OR Miura OR Weichai": no new item; recycled the Miura/Ceres 4.2kW launch and Weichai/Ceres manufacturing-licence background.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter, AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (28 MW, operational), NTT DATA (900 MW, global, shipments from 2027).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), Texas CRA (75 MW), SDCL (up to 450 MW). Also hosting a DOE/national-lab-backed R&D testbed (StabilityMax) in Danbury, CT. No named commercial deployment live yet.
Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B); supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only; no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
